title.zh: 授权拨款资助国家自来水与下水道管理局，用于菲律宾供水加氟的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds as Aid to the National Waterworks and Sewerage Authority for the Fluoridation of Water Supplies in the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds as Aid to the National Waterworks and Sewerage Authority for the Fluoridation of Water Supplies in the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3626_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of four hundred thousand pesos for the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-four and the sum of three hundred thousand pesos for every fiscal year thereafter are hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as aid to the National Waterworks and Sewerage Authority for the flouridation of water supplies in the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
